## Introduction

Crossfitting example

## Part 1

- Treatments:
  - Two linear treatments + interaction
  - Continuous
- Confounders:
  - Two linear confounders
  - Continuous

$$\mathbb{E}[Y\vert{}T,X] = \beta_1 T_1 + \beta_2 T_2 + \beta_{inter} (T_1 \times T_2) + g(X)$$ 
### Data set up

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(sjPlot)
```

```{r}
n <- 10000

## Confounders (X)
x1 <- rnorm(n)
x2 <- rnorm(n)
```

```{r}
## Continuous Treatments (correlated with confounders)
t1 <- 0.5 * x1 + 0.3 * x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)
t2 <- -0.4 * x1 + 0.6 * x2 + rnorm(n, sd = 0.5)
```

```{r}
## Outcome
beta_t1 <- 2.0
beta_t2 <- 3.5
beta_inter <- 1.2

y <- (beta_t1 * t1) + 
  (beta_t2 * t2) + 
  (beta_inter * (t1 * t2)) + 
  (1.5 * x1 + 2.0 * x2) + 
  rnorm(n)

# Combine into a data frame
df <- data.frame(y = y, t1 = t1, t2 = t2, t1t2 = t1 * t2, x1 = x1, x2 = x2)
```


### Cross-fitting 

First run a cross-fitting loop where we orthogonalize the treatments and the interaction

```{r}
nfolds <- 5
folds <- sample(rep(1:nfolds, length.out = n))

## Store expected values
hat_t1 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t2 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_t1t2 <- rep(NA, n)
hat_y  <- rep(NA, n)

## Loop over the folds
for (k in 1:nfolds) {
  train_id <- which(folds != k)
  eval_id  <- which(folds == k)
  
  train_data <- df[train_id, ]
  eval_data  <- df[eval_id, ]
  
  ## Outcome model
  model_y  <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  ## Propensity models
  model_t1 <- lm(t1 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t2 <- lm(t2 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)
  model_t1t2 <- lm(t1t2 ~ x1 + x2, data = train_data)

  ## Get predicted values
  hat_y[eval_id]  <- predict(model_y, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t1[eval_id] <- predict(model_t1, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t2[eval_id] <- predict(model_t2, newdata = eval_data)
  hat_t1t2[eval_id] <- predict(model_t1t2, newdata = eval_data)
}

## Calculate residuals
df$res_y  <- df$y - hat_y
df$res_t1 <- df$t1 - hat_t1
df$res_t2 <- df$t2 - hat_t2
df$res_t1t2_1 <- df$t1t2 - hat_t1t2
```

### Final stage model

- With orthogonalized interaction

```{r}
final_model <- lm(res_y ~ 0 + res_t1 + res_t2 + res_t1t2_1, data = df)

tab_model(final_model)
```

- With manually calculated interaction

```{r}
df$res_t1t2_2 <- (df$t1 * df$t2) - (hat_t1 * hat_t2)

final_model <- lm(res_y ~ 0 + res_t1 + res_t2 + res_t1t2_2, data = df)

tab_model(final_model)

```

- Sanity check on the full model w/ confounders

```{r}
single_model <- lm(y ~ x1 + x2 + t1 + t2 + t1:t2)

tab_model(single_model)
```

```{r}
plot(df$res_t1t2_1, df$res_t1t2_2)
```
